evidence: The restart-helper contract drifts. tests/test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER after generating app-restart.sh, and tests/tools/restart_mcp.py:14 exposes restart_app. tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:203 requires the verifier-provided restart_app tool to prove persistence across process restart, and tests/app_context.md:5,7 refers to that tool. But the parsed functional judge.toml has exactly one judge.mcp_servers entry, playwright at lines 8-12; [scoring] starts at line 14. It never declares the verifier MCP server or passes $APP_RESTART_HELPER. The frozen template's tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 does declare that server and argument. Therefore the requested tool is unavailable to the functional judge, so a conforming app cannot supply the required restart observation and a reload-only app cannot be distinguished on that leg. Other sampled agreements hold: port 3000 appears in integration.md:3, test.sh:48,108,136,164, app_context.md:3, all prompt.md:1, and server.js:142; test.sh:97-109 and integration.md:3 agree on entry and launch; test.sh:109,165 and server.js:8 agree on DB_PATH; task.toml:31-32 and each judge.toml:2 agree on claude-code fallback with model only in verifier.env; scoring.toml:6-8 has 0.6/0.2/0.2, read by tools/score.py:30,46. Parsed criterion counts are render 1, constraints 2, functional 23, polish 2, visual 3; task.toml quotes no count. The raw-evidence-index.json named in the assignment is absent, so this is source inspection, not a measured judge run.
counterexample: A correct app saves to durable server storage and survives a complete server restart, but the functional judge cannot invoke restart_app because it only receives the Playwright MCP server; its restart criterion remains unverified. Conversely, an app that only survives reload can look the same without the missing process-restart witness.
suggested_fix: Restore the template's verifier MCP server block in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml, with command /usr/local/bin/python3 and args ["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"], then measure the configured restart criterion on the repaired candidate.
